'''Lema Eelyak''' was a [[human]] [[Gender|female]] who worked with the [[Resistance]]. She lived during the [[Cold War]] thirty [[Standard year|years]] after the [[Battle of Endor]].<ref name="Episode VII" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Lema Eelyak was portrayed by [[Claudia Sermbezis]] in the [[2015]] film [[Star Wars: Episode VII The Force Awakens|''Star Wars'': Episode VII ''The Force Awakens'']]. Her role was confirmed in the movie's end credits.
